forms.title: Ashby hosted application (jobs.ashbyhq.com/<org>/<uuid>/application), client-rendered
quirks: client-rendered SPA: empty #root + window.__appData, form appears after an async load with a skeleton
no <form> element: Submit Application is a click handler
fields keyed by path: _systemfield_* and uuids; labels via .ashby-application-form-question-title
Overview / Application tabs; description lives in the (hidden) Overview panel
Autofill from resume pane with its own file input (feeds the Resume field)
file drop zones: Upload File button over hidden input, drag-and-drop supported
location autocomplete combobox (_systemfield_location) that must be picked from the list
Boolean questions as Yes/No toggle buttons with aria-pressed (no inputs)
MultiValueSelect checkbox group, ValueSelect radio group
EEOC survey ValueSelects as Select... comboboxes with snake_case values
errors: per-field 'Missing entry for required field' plus 'Your form needs corrections' summary
JSON POST via fetch with files inline (base64), success view swap, then redirect
forms.reference: Public jobs.ashbyhq.com application pages and the public non-user-graphql ApiJobPosting form definitions (ramp, notion, linear); DOM from Ashby's hosted job board class names
